entityDescription:
Founded in 2021, GreenAnt has been focusing on developing tools for climate resilience and has operated in Thailand and Vietnam. In 2023, we merged with SarVision, a Wageningen University’s data analysis spin-off, to become a leader in analyzing radar satellite data to provide climate adaptation tools and services.
 
We have developed unique intellectual property for analyzing radar data. Desidera, our flagship product, offers data-backed services to help manage climate risks. This includes predicting harvest failures, assessing flood risks, and estimating damages promptly after such events. Our approach combines artificial intelligence with extensive satellite data, offering a powerful tool for insurers, farmers, and traders to collaboratively tackle climate risks.
 
Using our AI-powered SaaS platform, Desidera, users have the flexibility to choose from a variety of subscription packages to obtain services such as EUDR certifications, comprehensive floods and harvest insurance policy bundles, and a variety of data-driven tools for evaluating and managing climate risks.
 
By making satellite data analysis accessible to the sectors most exposed to climate risk, we aim to promote sustainability and climate stewardship, across agriculture, real estate, and insurance.

entityDescription:
Alpine Data Ventures GmbH (ADV) is an independent data and artificial intelligence consultancy based in Munich, Germany. Founded in 2025 by four partners with senior backgrounds in corporate data leadership, data engineering, business intelligence and AI product development, ADV supports organisations in building the data foundations, architectures and AI capabilities required to operate in regulated and mission-critical environments.
The company covers the full data lifecycle across three practice areas. Data Strategy and Governance includes data strategy development, governance frameworks, data catalogues, master data management, maturity assessments and organisational enablement. Data Engineering and Architecture includes data warehouses, data lakes, data mesh implementations, ETL and pipeline development, enterprise architecture management and sovereign, European hosted data platforms. AI and Data Science includes machine learning, computer vision for automated visual inspection and object detection, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, forecasting and demand planning, digital twin and simulation, and retrieval augmented generation for technical documentation and knowledge access.
Information security and data protection form a cross-cutting fourth competence. ADV provides external Data Protection Officer mandates under GDPR, external Information Security Officer mandates, ISMS implementation aligned to ISO 27001, NIS2 compliance assessments, and identity and access management concepts. Members of the management team hold TÜV certification as Data Protection Officer and as IT Security Officer.
ADV operates on a principle of accountability the company describes as Skin in the Game: it stands behind what it recommends and implements it where required. Engagements are delivered by senior consultants working directly with the client, from short assessments through to multi-year mandates.
Clients include industrial and manufacturing companies as well as public sector bodies at federal, state and municipal level in Germany. Working languages are German and English.

Robert Faber / TerraMath is an independent geoscientific software and consulting company, founded in Austria in 2003. After operating from Southeast Asia between 2010 and 2021, TerraMath re-established its legal seat in Kapfenberg, Austria, in 2022.
TerraMath builds software for geological, environmental, traffic, and communication challenges — reaching from the subsurface to space — in close collaboration with universities and the research and development departments of industry partners.
Core competences span numerical simulation, algorithm design, terrain and scientific data visualisation (OpenGL/CUDA), GIS and remote sensing, geological and climate modelling, and simulation tools for railway, aviation, and satellite communication systems. Projects combine algorithmic and numerical-method development with robust software engineering in C++, Python, and web technologies, delivered as custom applications, analysis pipelines, and technical consulting for research-driven work.

entityDescription:
Xplore 4D is a Slovak SME specialized in digital twins, geospatial visualization, immersive XR technologies (VR/AR), AI-assisted spatial analysis and advanced 3D data integration. The company develops digital platforms and interactive environments that combine geospatial information, GIS technologies, 3D modelling, simulation tools and data-driven decision support systems.
Xplore 4D focuses on the creation of digital twins for territories, cultural heritage sites, tourism destinations, natural environments and infrastructure assets. The company delivers solutions for visualization, monitoring, planning, education, public engagement and operational support through interactive digital environments.
The company’s activities include geospatial data processing, integration of Earth Observation and remote sensing data, spatial analytics, artificial intelligence applications, interactive visualization, virtual and augmented reality experiences, simulation environments, and digital transformation projects for public and private sector stakeholders.
Xplore 4D supports the preservation and interpretation of cultural and natural heritage through advanced digital technologies, including 3D reconstruction, immersive storytelling, educational applications and interactive knowledge platforms. The company also develops innovative solutions for environmental monitoring, smart territory management and data-driven spatial decision-making.
The legal entity was incorporated on 18 December 2021. Following a strategic transformation completed in September 2025, the company adopted its current technology-focused business model and operates under the Xplore 4D brand. Since then, its activities have been dedicated to the development of digital twin technologies, geospatial applications, AI-enabled analytics and immersive visualization solutions.
Xplore 4D seeks collaboration with research organisations, industry partners, public institutions and international consortia in the fields of Earth Observation, digital twins, space-enabled applications, environmental monitoring, cultural heritage, smart territories, education and advanced visualization technologies.

entityDescription:
Graniot Satellite Technologies S.L. is a geospatial analytics company based in Granada (Spain), founded in 2022. The company transforms satellite imagery into actionable insights through a cloud-based SaaS platform and REST API. Graniot specializes in three technical verticals:

- Agriculture & Vegetation Monitoring – parcel mapping, crop and tree analytics, biomass and vegetation indices, and high-resolution monitoring to support agronomists and producers in optimizing field operations.
- Deforestation Compliance & Supply Chain Verification – automated detection of deforestation and protected-area overlap for compliance with regulations such as the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR). Graniot integrates directly into existing traceability platforms, acting as a technical partner without requiring clients to build their own geospatial team.
- Infrastructure and Territory Monitoring – remote supervision of works and land-use changes using high-resolution and very high-resolution satellite imagery, enabling visibility, progress analytics, and detection of materials or objects on the ground.

Graniot’s value proposition focuses on delivering ready-to-use analytics, automated reporting, and seamless integration via API. The company has an international application scope and works with organizations in agriculture, agri-tech, sustainability, and infrastructure management.

- Deforestation Compliance & Supply Chain Verification – automated detection of deforestation and protected-area overlap for compliance with regulations such as the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR). Graniot integrates directly into existing traceability platforms, acting as a technical partner without requiring clients to build their own geospatial team.
- Infrastructure and Territory Monitoring – remote supervision of works and land-use changes using high-resolution and very high-resolution satellite imagery, enabling visibility, progress analytics, and detection of materials or objects on the ground.

Graniot’s value proposition focuses on delivering ready-to-use analytics, automated reporting, and seamless integration via API. The company has an international application scope and works with organizations in agriculture, agri-tech, sustainability, and infrastructure management.

entityDescription:
Grawlr is a security validation and compliance management platform that helps organizations understand their own digital risks, assess suppliers, and maintain an auditable record of their security and compliance activities.
The platform combines automated DAST security testing, real-world attack intelligence, supplier due diligence, compliance questionnaires, reporting, and audit trails in one environment.

With Grawlr, organizations can
• Identify vulnerabilities and unnecessary information exposure across websites, APIs, and other digital assets
• Test systems against real-world attack patterns
• Assess suppliers and partners using ready-made or custom questionnaires
• Manage frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001, DORA, SOC 2, GDPR, TISAX, and PCI DSS
• Collect and review supplier responses, findings, and supporting evidence
• Maintain a detailed audit trail of security and compliance activity
• Generate reports and practical recommendations
• Manage multiple websites, partners, users, and assessments from a single dashboard

Grawlr helps technical, compliance, risk, and procurement teams move beyond assumptions by combining what organizations and suppliers say about their security with what can be independently observed.
